transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you for seeing me. Um, I guess my supervisor at the warehouse told me I had to come in. I hope that's okay. They, um, they said I was doing some things that were... distracting, I guess? 

Like, sometimes I just sort of... pause by the forklift with my arms up. It's not a big deal, really, I'm just trying to be careful, you know? But they said I was freezing there. And I might have been, um, making the beeping noises the forklift makes, or copying the hand signals the drivers use. I didn't mean to bother anyone, I was just trying to fit in with the work flow, is that alright? 

They also got a little upset because I was arranging the boxes in these specific patterns. It made sense to me, but they were yelling at me to stop. I really didn't mean to cause any trouble, I just... I get a little caught up in how things are supposed to move, I think. Does that make sense? I really want to be a good worker.
When did you first notice yourself having these freezing moments and copying sounds or movements?

Um... well, I guess... it's been a little while. Maybe about six months? I really didn't think it was that noticeable, honestly. My supervisor told me that the... the strange behavior, and I guess sometimes my talking gets a little confusing for them... they said all of that has been happening for about six months now. 

I promise I was still trying my best to do a good job, though. I hope it's not too bad that it's been going on that long. I just didn't want to make a fuss or have anyone think I couldn't handle the work, you know? I really do want to be helpful. Am I answering your question okay?
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or had any physical health problems recently?

Oh, um, no, Doctor. I don't have any medical conditions or anything like that. My body works just fine, really. I try very hard to stay healthy so I can keep up with all the lifting and moving at work, you know? 

So, I haven't had any physical problems or needed to see a regular doctor for anything. I hope that's okay? I mean, I hope that's a helpful answer for your notes. I'm generally a very healthy person.
